title: Chocolate Caramel Oat Bars (Carmelitas)
description: Gooey, decadent bars with layers of caramel, chocolate and chewy oats.

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13-inch (22 x 33 cm) baking pan with parchment paper and coat it lightly with nonstick spray.
In a large bowl, mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, baking soda, salt and melted butter until well combined and crumbly.
Press about half the oat mixture into the pan in a compact, even layer with the back of a spoon or spatula. Save the rest.
Spread the middle-layer chocolate chips evenly over the oat layer.
In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, melt the caramels with the cream until smooth.
Pour the caramel over the chocolate chips and spread it until the chips are covered.
Scatter the remaining oat mixture evenly over the caramel, then sprinkle the topping chocolate chips over it.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the crust is golden brown (ovens vary). Let cool completely before cutting into bars.

notes: Total time doesn't include prep or cooling; the source doesn't give them.
